key_concepts: An earthquake is the sudden shaking of the ground from rapid release of energy inside Eart
A fault is a fracture between two blocks of rock
Faults form from stress or energy released from inside Earth
Fault parts include the fault plane, hanging wall, and footwall
Friction locks rocks along a fault; slip releases stored energy and causes shaking
Tensional stress pulls rocks apart and forms normal faults
Compressional stress pushes rocks together and forms reverse or thrust faults
Shear stress makes rocks slide past one another and forms strike-slip faults
